reviews.shade: SKINFOOD Royal Honey Propolis Enrich Essence
reviews.text: Love how luxuriously hydrating this feels! I also love the cute bottle and the way it automatically dispenses the right amount of serum with the dropper. I’ll definitely be ordering more.
reviews.zh: 好鍾意呢款嘅奢華保濕觸感！我亦都好鍾意個樽好得意，而且用滴管可以自動出到剛剛好嘅精華分量。一定會再回購。

reviews.shade: SKINFOOD Royal Honey Propolis Enrich Essence
reviews.text: Purchased this to compare with CNP propolis ampoule/serum. This was slightly bit thicker, but went on so beautifully. My skin loved it, as it was very hydrating, and moisturizing, and the hydrated feeling lasted longer than with the CNP. I still love to use the CNP on daily basis, but when I want to give my skin some extra TLC, I use this one.
reviews.zh: 買咗呢款係想同 CNP 嘅 propolis 安瓶/精華做比較。呢款稍微稠少少，但上臉效果好好。皮膚好鍾意，因為佢非常保濕、滋潤，保濕感仲持久過 CNP。我平時日日都用 CNP，但想俾皮膚多啲呵護嘅時候就會用呢款。

reviews.shade: SKINFOOD Royal Honey Propolis Enrich Essence
reviews.text: I really like this, this is my second time getting this product and my skin definitely feels and looks more plump. The serum is thick and viscous and it absorbs into the skin easily.
reviews.zh: 真係好鍾意呢款，已經係第二次回購，皮膚明顯感覺同望落都更加飽滿。精華質地濃厚有黏度，但好容易就俾皮膚吸收。

reviews.shade: SKINFOOD Royal Honey Propolis Enrich Essence
reviews.text: Is a thicker serum, but hasn’t caused any breakouts. Very moisturizing. Love that it doesn’t have added fragrance, and I use it in when I want to boost my skin barrier and moisture content.
reviews.zh: 質地偏厚，但用咗無爆瘡。非常保濕。好鍾意佢冇添加香料，想強化皮膚屏障同保濕嘅時候我就會用。

reviews.shade: SKINFOOD Royal Honey Propolis Enrich Essence
reviews.text: Not my favorite, I didn't really notice a chnage when using this product in my personal opinion.
reviews.zh: 唔係我嘅最愛，個人意見係用緊呢款產品期間我真係冇乜嘢感覺到。

reviews.shade: SKINFOOD Royal Honey Propolis Enrich Essence
reviews.text: I first used this when it came out. Since then it’s been one of my favorites. It’s so moisturizing. The texture is great and it smells so nice. The packaging is also of a good quality. My skin always looks amazing on the next day.
reviews.zh: 一出嘅時候我就用緊，自此之後佢一直係我最愛之一。非常保濕。質地好好，味道又好聞。包裝都幾有質素。用完第二日皮膚望落總係好靚。

reviews.shade: SKINFOOD Royal Honey Propolis Enrich Essence
reviews.text: This essence is my holy grail. I will always try to incorporate it in between my skincare routines whenever I feel my skin needs that extra moisturization. I have very pimple-prone skin, but this is amazing at leaving my skin feeling like it's cared for throughout the year.
reviews.zh: 呢款精華係我嘅神級產品。每當我覺得皮膚需要額外保濕嘅時候，一定會將佢加入我嘅護膚程序之間。我皮膚非常容易生暗瘡，但呢款用完會令皮膚成日都感覺到被呵護，效果好驚喜。

reviews.shade: SKINFOOD Royal Honey Propolis Enrich Essence
reviews.text: I’ve used different Propolis serums but this one is my favorite! I have oily skin and other serums/essence were too thick even during the winter making my skin oily after a few hours. But this essence is light and sinks in to my skin quickly but doesn’t irritate my skin. I’m not sure if this moisturizing enough for dry skin but I think it’s good for combo and oily skin during the winter.
reviews.zh: 用過唔同嘅 Propolis 精華，但呢款係我最愛！我係油性肌，其他精華/乳液就算冬天用都太厚，用幾個鐘之後就成面油。但呢款精華好清爽，好快就俾皮膚吸收，又唔會刺激皮膚。唔知夠唔夠保濕俾乾性肌用，但覺得冬天用喺混合性同油性肌身上效果唔錯。
